summary: Thirty years of practice and a wide range of services are strong, but dead links and placeholder content appear to weaken the first impression.

findings.problem: The FAQ questions, the Proven Legacy of Excellence block and the blog categories link to #, and the menu shows the text [IMAGE].
findings.cost: Dead links and leftover labels make a long established firm look unfinished.
findings.fix: Working links and a clean menu.

findings.problem: The team and client images appear to be empty placeholders, and the statistics render as 10 / k+ instead of 10k+.
findings.cost: Broken figures and missing photos reduce the proof clients rely on.
findings.fix: Real team photos and clean figures.

findings.problem: Experience is stated as Since 1993, 30+ Years and over 200 years, and the LinkedIn links differ between header and footer.
findings.cost: Mixed claims make clients question every number.

findings.problem: No enquiry form shows, the contact sections list only phone, email and address, and no WhatsApp number appears.
findings.cost: Clients who want to message first have no easy option and some will leave.
findings.fix: A short enquiry form and a WhatsApp button.

redesign: Working links, a clean menu and real team photos.
One verified set of facts and figures across the site.
A short enquiry form and WhatsApp on every page.
